messages:
alex: quick flag: invoice-preview shows a step-up in billed tokens for 'preview' route after the route pricing change at 06:00 UTC. small tenant set appears impacted. anyone seeing header loss on retry paths?

maya: pulling samples now. query: `SELECT tenant_id, retry_count, count(1), sum(tokens) FROM ingress.raw WHERE route='preview' AND ts >= '2026-03-10T06:00Z' GROUP BY tenant_id, retry_count LIMIT 100` 

rico: I grabbed raw lines via `kcat -C -b kafka:9092 -t ingress-raw -p 12 -o -1000 | jq -c 'select(.route=="preview")' | head -n 200`  most entries with retry_count>0 are missing `X-Route-Hint`.

devops: deploy-bot: proxy-sidecar v2.14.1 rolled to canary set at 05:58 UTC; rollout continued at 06:02. No crash loops.

alex: likely root cause: retry path in sidecar didn't copy over custom headers. Impact: aggregation step joins by route_hint, defaulting to list_price when NULL -> visible spike in billed tokens.

maya: two remediation choices: 1) rollback sidecar; 2) enrich at ingest to backfill route_hint for preview route when missing using tenant->promo lookup. My preference: ingest enrichment + targeted backfill so we can correct previews and avoid infra churn.

rico: agree. enrichment must be idempotent and logged. Proposal: add header `X-Route-Hint-Backfilled=true` and emit `enrich.backfill.preview` metric. Only apply when route='preview' AND route_hint is NULL AND retry_count>0.

billing-bot: Finance: if we backfill retroactively we'll need ledger adjustments and notify some customers. Please estimate affected_token_sum and USD delta before broad replay.

alex: maya, can you include a query for affected_token_sum and top 10 tenants by tokens? ops will use that to scope communications.

maya: on it. quick query: `SELECT tenant_id, sum(tokens) as tok FROM ingest.agg WHERE route='preview' AND route_hint IS NULL AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-10T06:00Z' AND '2026-03-11T06:00Z' GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY tok DESC LIMIT 10;` will produce the list.

devops: rollback checklist ready if needed: connection-drain window 30s, healthchecks, rate-limited roll back over canary set. Note: some dedicated customers on canary may see brief disconnects.

rico: test action item: add a smoke e2e that sends a request with retry=1 through proxy and asserts the `X-Route-Hint` survives. I'll add to routing-tests.

alex: console UX item: add a "pricing-source" tag on invoice preview rows (values: header, enriched, unknown) and surface a tooltip explaining rules. This avoids surprise when invoices change after backfills.

maya: PR created: github.com/redwood/infer/ingest/pull/412  includes enrichment, metric emit, and the backfill header. Local perf test shows ~0.02ms additional CPU per event at 2k QPS.

billing-bot: estimate request pending: include sample tenant list + projected USD impact. Finance will triage which require outreach.

devops: plan: deploy enrichment to canary for 10m, watch `enrich.backfill.preview` and consumer lag. If stable, replay 1h window initially, validate invoice-preview alignment, then expand to 24h.

alex: keep this thread as the single source for decisions. Thanks. :thumbsup:
